description:
Goal
Close the arc by making the pull-based model the documented compiler2 artifact model and by deleting temporary planning scaffolding.

Required docs
- northstar.html: replace semantic closure/artifact ladder root-pass language with product-keyed pull language. Remove or clearly mark follow_up as legacy.
- .agent/docs/fact-engine.md: document ProductKey pull driver and state that new artifact producers return waits instead of follow_up jobs.
- .agent/docs/semantic-fixpoint.md: remove any claim that the seal/frontier jobs are the desired target model once replacement lands.
- .agent/docs/pipeline.md: replace the root artifact ladder with per-product inventory and final packaging boundary.
- User-facing guides only if they describe compiler2 telemetry, dumps, backend products, or semantic closure behavior.

Signal
Docs describe one model: product-keyed demand pulls exactly the products named by local dependencies; final dense packaging is the only root-wide assembly step; follow_up, walkers, passes, and whole fact-table scans are not normalized for the new path.

Removal target
Delete or archive ../pull-based.html only if its content has been fully absorbed into durable docs. Otherwise leave it as a referenced plan artifact and create a cleanup ticket if it should not remain.

Verification
Documentation review against the implemented code, rg for stale SemanticClosed/root frontier language in docs, and full focused test set from the parent epic.
title: Pull path: update docs and remove planning scaffolding
